A small closed handbag hangs naturally from one hand. Her expression is serene and friendly. Use cinematic coral twilight, deep teal building silhouettes, soft reflected window light, and elegant fabric movement. Keep every garment modest and fully covering. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
